item.title: 🔵 Sponsored: AI is attacking… it needs to defend, too
item.description:
Why this matters: Potentially urgent issue — confirm whether your environment is exposed.
In this Risky Business sponsored interview James Wilson chats with Prowler’s founder and CEO Toni de la Fuente about how AI now allows pretty much anyone to vibe-code “killer apps”. These custom apps are often internal for organisations and hosted on the cloud. The pair discuss why developers need to focus on security on top of app functionality and how Prowler can work in parallel with apps and agents to help secure, and continuously assess, cloud infrastructure.

Source: Risky Business News  |  Severity: FYI  |  Age: 11h
